description: Additive Stage 4 storage contract. The Stage 1 architecture manifest remains a frozen historical description of its original 22 stores.

bookingTransactions.authority: Durable booking requests, stable identity assignments, execution checkpoints and completion receipts. Domain objects remain authoritative in Workspace, Book-In and Admin stores.
bookingTransactions.migration: Missing key means no journal. Version 1 requires a transactions dictionary; malformed or unsupported journal data must not be overwritten or interpreted as empty.
bookingTransactions.backup: Exact registered raw bytes are included in the recovery archive regardless of portable=false.
bookingTransactions.transfer: Excluded from normal transfer exports and imports: a recovery request belongs to its original workspace.

fields.request: Unfinished transactions retain request.packet and request.options for recovery. Completed receipts may omit the request.
fields.identity: Dictionary key equals transactionId; supplied booking, subject, Encounter, Person, Lead and Arrest identifiers must agree with request and durable records.
